description: Node details by id (geometry, fills, auto-layout, text, variable binds). Default-valued props are omitted unless verbose. Composite instance ids resolve; unknown ids land in notFound. Find ids with figma_search_nodes.

depth.description: minimal (id, name, type, childIds), compact (+ x/y/size, parentId, childIds), full (all props; default).

verbose.description: Include default-valued props and skip caps on long fields

name: figma_get_nodes
